license_note: Google provided Gemini 2.0 Flash as a managed service under the Gemini API Additional Terms of Service, which incorporate the Google APIs Terms of Service and a Prohibited Use Policy. The terms permit customer applications but prohibit extracting or replicating model components such as parameter weights, so nothing is licensed for self-operation.

license_evidence.scope: Access to the Gemini 2.0 release through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, including the incorporated Google APIs Terms of Service and Prohibited Use Policy

access_boundary: This record represents the Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite line identified by the model code gemini-2.0-flash-lite (public preview February 2025, general availability February 25, 2025, shut down June 1, 2026). The -001 version, the 2.0 Flash variant, the retired Flash-Lite Preview, the Vertex AI and Gemini app products, and later Gemini releases remain separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Google documents the full lifecycle from experimental preview to announced deprecation and executed shutdown with named replacements
The model page, deprecations table, and changelog each name the release and its shutdown date
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights were ever available for self-operation
The release is shut down, so new API traffic must migrate to the named successor

evidence.label: Official Gemini API deprecations and model lifecycle page
